sections.title: Pickable Passives
sections.description: Sombra has taken over the Quick Play game modes again and will be giving you an extra boost of your choice with Pickable Passives. For the next two days, you can pick an additional passive to benefit the role you are playing in.

blocks.body: Pickable Passives will take over the Quick Play ruleset from July 15 to July 16. All players will be able to choose one of three selectable passives for their role to get an extra benefit for their hero. Choose and change your passive anytime in the start of the game, in the spawn room, or while in the respawn phase of after being eliminated. Standard Role Passives also remain in effect.

blocks.title: Pickable Tank Passives
blocks.body: Unyielding - Debuff duration reduced by 40%. Armored - Convert 100 health into Armor. Last Stand - 50% cooldown reduction when below 50% HP.

blocks.title: Pickable Damage Passives
blocks.body: Slayer - See critical health enemies through walls. Trigger Happy - Increase ammo capacity by 20%. Frenzy - Eliminations grant a brief 30% speed boost.

blocks.title: Pickable Support Passives
blocks.body: Resourceful – Reduce cooldowns by 20%. Swift Save – Increase Healing by 50% for targets below 35% HP. Close Call – Gain a brief 20% speed boost when below 50% HP.
